name: talk-to-action-for-raycast
title: Talk to Action for Raycast
description: Save quick text input directly to Markdown files in an Obsidian Vault.
author: kuraki

commands.name: daily-input
commands.title: Talk to Action for Raycast
commands.description: Save text to a configured Obsidian route
commands.subtitle: Direct Markdown save

preferences.name: vaultPath
preferences.title: Obsidian Vault
preferences.description: Choose the root folder of the Vault. Files are never written outside it.

preferences.name: dailyNoteFolder
preferences.title: Daily Note - Folder
preferences.description: Vault-relative folder. The Daily Note file must already exist.

preferences.name: dailyNoteFileFormat
preferences.title: Daily Note - File Format
preferences.description: Existing file name format using YYYY, MM, and DD.

preferences.name: openObsidianAfterSave
preferences.title: Open Obsidian After Save
preferences.description: Open the saved Markdown file in Obsidian after a successful save.
preferences.label: Open saved note

preferences.name: noteDestination
preferences.title: Daily Note - Destination
preferences.description: Where Daily Note input is saved.

preferences.name: noteFilePath
preferences.title: Daily Note - File Path
preferences.description: Vault-relative Markdown path for Existing File.

preferences.name: notePosition
preferences.title: Daily Note - Position
preferences.description: Append to the end or prepend to the beginning when no section is selected.

preferences.name: noteSection
preferences.title: Daily Note - Section
preferences.description: Insert at a heading instead of using the file position.

preferences.name: noteHeading
preferences.title: Daily Note - Heading
preferences.description: Heading name without the # characters.

preferences.name: noteLineFormat
preferences.title: Daily Note - Line Format
preferences.description: How each saved line starts.

preferences.name: noteAddCurrentTime
preferences.title: Daily Note - Add Current Time
preferences.description: Add the current short time after the line marker.
preferences.label: Add time

preferences.name: taskDestination
preferences.title: To Do - Destination
preferences.description: Where To Do input is saved.

preferences.name: taskFilePath
preferences.title: To Do - File Path
preferences.description: Vault-relative Markdown path for Existing File.

preferences.name: taskPosition
preferences.title: To Do - Position
preferences.description: Append to the end or prepend to the beginning when no section is selected.

preferences.name: taskSection
preferences.title: To Do - Section
preferences.description: Insert at a heading instead of using the file position.

preferences.name: taskHeading
preferences.title: To Do - Heading
preferences.description: Heading name without the # characters.

preferences.name: taskLineFormat
preferences.title: To Do - Line Format
preferences.description: How each saved line starts.

preferences.name: taskAddCurrentTime
preferences.title: To Do - Add Current Time
preferences.description: Add the current short time after the task marker.
preferences.label: Add time

preferences.name: shoppingDestination
preferences.title: Shopping - Destination
preferences.description: Where Shopping input is saved.

preferences.name: shoppingFilePath
preferences.title: Shopping - File Path
preferences.description: Vault-relative Markdown path. Required for the default Existing File route.

preferences.name: shoppingPosition
preferences.title: Shopping - Position
preferences.description: Append to the end or prepend to the beginning when no section is selected.

preferences.name: shoppingSection
preferences.title: Shopping - Section
preferences.description: Insert at a heading instead of using the file position.

preferences.name: shoppingHeading
preferences.title: Shopping - Heading
preferences.description: Heading name without the # characters.

preferences.name: shoppingLineFormat
preferences.title: Shopping - Line Format
preferences.description: How each saved line starts.

preferences.name: shoppingAddCurrentTime
preferences.title: Shopping - Add Current Time
preferences.description: Add the current short time after the task marker.
preferences.label: Add time

scripts.lint: eslint src --max-warnings=0 && prettier --check "src/**/*.{ts,tsx}" "tests/**/*.ts" package.json README.md REFERENCES.md tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: echo "This package is a Raycast Extension. Use npm run publish for the Raycast Store." && exit 1
